text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've been on a real losing streak lately,
haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think it's about time we reverse that
trend.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It would be irresponsible to claim I could
win if I
didn't, dear.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win and turn the tide!
